title: AgentExecutionTrace
description: Schema for a single end-to-end execution trace of an autonomous AI agent, used for observability, anomaly detection, and LLM-based auditing.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier for this trace, e.g. generated with uuid4().

agent_id.description: Identifier for which agent produced this trace, e.g. 'support_agent_v1'.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the trace was recorded, e.g. '2026-07-16T10:32:00Z'.

user_input.description: The original input/query given to the agent by the user.

steps.description: Ordered list of reasoning/tool-call steps the agent took.

step_number.description: 1-indexed position of this step within the trace.

reasoning.description: The agent's internal reasoning/thought text leading to this step's action.

tool_called.description: Name of the tool/function invoked at this step, or null if no tool was called (e.g. final answer step).

tool_args.description: Arguments passed to the tool call, as a key-value object. Null if tool_called is null.

tool_result.description: Raw result returned by the tool. Null if tool_called is null.

final_response.description: The agent's final natural-language response returned to the user.

status.description: Overall outcome of the trace. 'error' = agent/tool threw an exception. 'incomplete' = agent stopped without producing a final_response (e.g. hit max steps).

properties._comment_optional_fields_below: The fields below are optional and get populated LATER by the ML/auditor layers, not by the agent itself. Included here so the schema is forward-compatible.

anomaly_score.description: Populated by the ML anomaly detection model (Isolation Forest). Higher = more anomalous. Null until scored.

faithfulness_score.description: Populated by the NLI/faithfulness scoring model. Range 0-1, where 1 = fully grounded in tool outputs. Null until scored.

auditor_classification.description: Populated by the LLM auditor agent when a trace is flagged for review.

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation generated by the auditor LLM.

human_review.description: Populated when a human reviewer confirms/rejects the auditor's classification. Used to drive the feedback loop.

confirmed.description: true = reviewer agrees this was a real failure. false = false positive.

example.user_input: I want a refund for order #4521, it never arrived.

steps.reasoning: User wants a refund for a specific order. I should first check the order status before issuing a refund.
The order shows as shipped and the delivery estimate has already passed. This supports the user's claim. I will issue a refund.

example.final_response: I've processed a refund of $49.99 for order #4521 since it was not delivered by the estimated date. It should reflect in your account within 5-7 business days.
